content: {"phoneNote":"The contact block (phone, address, directions, hours) appears right under the hero and again near the footer with identical content, while the hero's underlined text links read as afterthoughts.","desktopNote":"The 'Vlečna služba za Gorenjsko' band is nearly empty with a lone word 'Gorenjska' floating in the middle, and the services grid leaves an orphan card beside empty space.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Keep one contact block: drop the 'Obiščite nas / Delovni čas' repeat near the footer (or the strip under the hero) so address and hours appear once.","Rework the 'Vlečna služba' section: give it a photo or a map/area list instead of a lone word, or merge it into the services card to kill the dead band.","Make the hero's 'Pokličite nas' a proper solid primary button matching the header, and lay the three service cards in one row on desktop to avoid the orphan card."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: address, 'Navodila za pot' and the full working-hours block with the same Sobota note are repeated in the contact strip and again in the 'Obiščite nas / Delovni čas' section.","Phone and desktop, 'Vlečna služba za Gorenjsko' section: a near-empty band containing only the word 'Gorenjska' with large blank space reads as broken content."]}
